_email_comment: Two addresses on purpose. eventsEmail is for private-event enquiries — the homepage events block and the private events page. `email` is everything else, including the privacy policy and terms, where the contact address has to stay stable.

promo._comment: Dated banners on the home page. Delete an item when it is over, or the whole promo block when none are running — renderPromo emits nothing without it, so no markup has to be touched either way.

items.heading: 1 Year Anniversary Party
items.body: Friday December 4th, 7–10pm, on the event court. Our holiday party and a toast to our first year at ELEVENO — come celebrate with us.
items.imageAlt: 1 Year Anniversary Party, over the ELEVENO courts

items.heading: Winter Classic Moneyball
items.body: Our biggest tournament of the year — and our First Anniversary Celebration. Friday December 18th through Sunday December 20th, here in Foxborough. Powered by BostonPickle.Life and DUPR.
items.imageAlt: ELEVENO Winter Classic Moneyball, First Anniversary Celebration. December 18 to 20, Foxborough, Massachusetts. Powered by BostonPickle.Life, with DUPR

items.heading: Euphoria Health & Fitness
items.body: Saturdays November 14th and 21st, 9–10am. Euphoria with Marina — 45 minutes of boxing, movement and power, here on the event court at ELEVENO.
items.imageAlt: ELEVENO Pickleball and Euphoria Health & Fitness logos over the ELEVENO courts and the Euphoria boxing gym

items.heading: Mahjong Monday
items.body: Monday November 9th and Monday November 16th, 11am–1pm. Tiles, friends and good times — choose guided play to learn the game, or open play if you already know it.
items.imageAlt: Mahjong Monday: tiles, friends and good times. November 9 and November 16, 11 AM to 1 PM

items.heading: DUPR Rating Sessions
items.body: Mondays November 9th, 16th, 23rd and 30th, 8–10pm. Get rated, track your progress, play your best.
items.imageAlt: DUPR Rating Sessions: get rated, track your progress, play your best. November 9, 16, 23 and 30, 8 to 10 PM

items.heading: Patriots in Munich Watch Party
items.body: Sunday November 15th, 9am–1pm. Football, friends, good vibes — catch the game on our screens with food and drinks from the bar.
items.imageAlt: Patriots in Munich Watch Party: football, friends, good vibes. November 15, 9 AM to 1 PM

items.heading: Tech Tuesday
items.body: Tuesday November 17th, 1:00–3:30pm, here at ELEVENO. Intra Systems, IGEL, Omnissa and Nutanix on modern workspaces — presentations first, then pickleball, beverages and appetizers.
items.imageAlt: Tech Tuesday: presentations first, then pickleball, beverages and appetizers. November 17, 1 to 3:30 PM

popup._comment: Modal on the pages listed below. Delete the whole popup block when the promotion is over: renderPopup emits nothing without it, and the popup script only ships on pages that get one. Change "id" to re-show the popup to people who already dismissed it.
popup.heading: Book your holiday party
popup.body: Nine indoor courts, two bars and a full kitchen under one roof. December dates go fast, so tell us what you have in mind and we'll build the package around it.
